name: MAPE (Make Armor Plate Effective)
teaser: Make armor plates to protect you like old tarkov (not completely)
description_html:
DO NOT USE WITH REALISM MOD’S BALLISTICS FEATURE

If you want to use both mods, turn off realism’s ballistics feature. (thanks GMAK3R for testing )

And also if you are using SAIN and feel like this mod does nothing, try raising bot’s scatter multiplier.

What is this?

This mod makes armor plates to work like old tarkov. (not completely same)

How it works?

Armor and Armor plate’s hitboxes use character’s body hitboxes(Thorax, Stomach, …) instead of BSG’s actual plate hitboxes(FR Plate, BK Plate).

This feature is applied to not only player but also every characters (scav, boss, … everyone). So TTK will be much longer than before.

Customization?

You can change some configs(Protection Type, Additional custom items, Armor plate protectable area.. and so on) in config/config.jsonc

I wrote comments in detail, so I believe you can understand them.

Compatibility

  • Tactical Gear Component by MoxoPixel
  • BlackCore by MoxoPixel
  • Artem by Crackbone
